assumptions: The history's steps are the ones the build actually took.
limits: Renders the history; it adds no reaction conditions the history lacks.
The SpliceCraft vectors it is graded against have no generator in the tree, so they cannot be regenerated.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: An export: the recorded steps written out as a bench protocol, with nothing inferred.
bio.jane/contract.question: What numbered bench protocol does a construct's build history describe?

description: Render a construct's build history into a numbered bench-recipe protocol.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.
